background_description: Kugira ngo igurinde mu gihe nyacyo 'Zero-Click' no kwiba amakuru, porogaramu ya Da-Costa ikeneye uruhushya rwo kugenzura ubutumwa bw'igikoresho cyawe no kubika itangazamakuru inyuma.
background_point1_desc: Duhagarika imfuruka mbi za WhatsApp n'imitwe ya videwo ishidikanywaho mbere y'uko ukandaho.
background_point2_desc: Dusesengura ijwi rya imeyili yinjiye kugira ngo tugaragaze uburiganya bwo kwiyitirira 'CEO'.
background_point3_desc: Da-Costa ikoresha Zero-Prompt AI. Ducunga amakuru y'uburinzi hano imbere kandi tukayasiba ako kanya. Ntabwo tujya tubika ibiganiro byawe bwite.
background_disclaimer: Nta ruhushya nk'uru, Da-Costa ishobora gusuzuma amadosiye n'intoki gusa iyo porogaramu ifunguye.
dashboard_subheader_full: Imiterere ya SOC ihuriweho irakora. Sentry y'inyuma mu gihe nyacyo iriho.
dashboard_subheader_limited: Imo yo gusuzuma n'intoki yashizweho. Uburinzi bwawe ntibwuzuye.
dashboard_limited_mode_card_desc: Sentry y'Inyuma yakuweho. Uburinzi bwawe bugarukira ku gusuzuma n'intoki muri porogaramu. Shira imbere uburinzi bwuzuye ku mutekano w'iteka mu gihe nyacyo.
dashboard_autonomous_desc: Da-Costa ubu ikora mu buryo bwa 'Zero-Interaction'. Jye-sisitemu isuzuma itangazamakuru ryose ryinjira, imfuruka n'itumanaho imbere ikoresheje uburyo bwa AI nta nyandiko.
dashboard_alerts_desc: Amakuru yo mu gihe nyacyo avuye mu mutekano wigenga.
dashboard_empty_desc: Nta nshuke y'inyuma yabonetse na Sentry.
account_page_desc: Genala ururimi rwawe, ubwishingizi, utubumbe n'igenamiterere ry'imari.
account_limited_protection_desc: Gukora Sentry y'Inyuma kuri SSE yose.
account_explore_premium_desc_free: Fungura ibintu byose kandi ubone isuzuma ritagira imipaka.
account_explore_premium_desc_premium: Reba ibishya bya premium kandi ugenala ubwishingizi bwawe.
account_feature_premium_auditors: Kugera ku Bagenzuzi bose ba Premium
payment_modal_terms_desc: Byishurwa binyuze kuri Google Play. Byifungura n'uwo mwaka keretse iyo bihagaritswe amasaha 24 mbere y'uko birangira.
payment_modal_terms_link: Soma amategeko yose y'Ubwishingizi na fagitire
payment_modal_terms_checkbox: Nasomye kandi nemeye amategeko y'Ubwishingizi na fagitire.
sovereignty_page_desc: Genala aho unyuze mu buryo bwa dijital n'igenamiterere rya sentry y'inyuma.
sovereignty_controls_desc: Genala uko amakuru yawe y'uburinzi abikwa kandi akurwamo.
sovereignty_open_portal_desc: Ibikoresho byo gusuzuma byo kuri murandasi
sovereignty_danger_zone_desc: Ibikorwa hano ntibisubirwaho kandi bihura n'Uburenganzira bwawe bwo Kwibagirwa.
sovereignty_erasure_desc: Siba konti yawe, amateka y'isuzuma, n'utubumbe dusigaye burundu.
sovereignty_delete_confirm_desc: Ibi bigiye gusiba konti yawe, utubumbe n'amateka burundu. Iki gikorwa ntigisubirwaho.
sovereignty_manual_request: Ifomu rusange yo gusaba gusiba (Gusuzumwa n'intoki)
sovereignty_reset_app_title: Seta Isanwa rya Porogaramu kuri Zero
sovereignty_reset_app_desc: Ibi bigiye kugusohora maze bitume utangira inzira yo kwinjira bundi bushya.
sovereignty_reset_confirm_desc: Ibi bigiye gusiba imiterere yawe yo kwinjira kandi bagusohore. Amakuru ya konti yawe ntayasibwa.
sovereignty_reset_toast_desc: Porogaramu ubu igiye gutangira bundi bushya.
lure_detector_page_desc: Kugaragaza uburiganya bwo mu mibanire kuri media n'ubutumwa bwawe.
lure_detector_logs_desc: Iziphumo zivuye mu ngenzuzi z'uburiganya bwo mu mibanire z'inyuma.
lure_detector_zero_interaction_desc: Da-Costa ikoresha ubuhanga bw'ikoranabuhanga n'intoki kugira ngo ibone uburiganya muri WhatsApp statuses na SMS utiriwe upakurura ibyawe.
lure_detector_mock_log_detail_phishing: Igerageza ryo kwiba amakuru ya banki
link_scrutinizer_page_desc: Isesengura rya URL n'uburinzi bw'imfuruka mu buryo bw'itumanaho.
link_scrutinizer_logs_desc: Isesengura ryo mu gihe nyacyo ry'imfuruka zabonetse mu butumwa no mu byacopishijwe.
link_scrutinizer_autonomous_desc: Da-Costa igenzura imfuruka zose za SMS na media zinjira. Igerageza ryo kwiba amakuru rimenyekana mbere y'uko ukandaho.
video_auditor_page_desc: Igenzura ryigenga ry'imitwe ya media n'ukumira ibitero.
video_auditor_logs_title: Amateka yo Gusuzuma Videwo ya Sentry
video_auditor_logs_desc: Isesengura ryo mu gihe nyacyo rya videwo nshya zibitse ku gikoresho cyawe (/WhatsApp/Media & /Download).
video_auditor_proactive_desc: Da-Costa igenzura ububiko bwawe kugira ngo ibone amadosiye mashya maze isuzume amakuru yayo kugira ngo imenye malware mbere y'uko ifungurwa.
email_analyzer_page_desc: Kugaragaza kwiyitirira undi n'uburinzi mu buryo bw'itumanaho.
email_analyzer_logs_desc: Iziphumo zo mu gihe nyacyo zivuye kuri IMAP y'inyuma ya Sentry.
email_analyzer_autonomous_desc: Da-Costa ubu igenzura agasanduku k'ubutumwa bwawe ku bagerageza BEC (Business Email Compromise) isebenzisa isesengura ry'indimi nta nyandiko.
email_accounts_page_desc: Genala serivisi zawe zo kugenzura inyuma za IMAP/OAuth2.
email_accounts_scanning_desc: Gusuzuma mu gihe nyacyo kwiyitirira undi
email_accounts_expired_desc: Ikarita ya OAuth2 yarangiye. Nceda uvugurure.
email_accounts_why_link_desc: Mu gufatanya binyuze kuri OAuth2, Da-Costa ikoresha IMAP IDLE kugira ngo imenye inshuke mu gihe zigeze muri inye-box.
email_accounts_why_link_li4: Isesengura rya Stateless: Dusesengura uburyo, ntabwo tubika ubutumwa.
admin_page_desc: Amakuru y'inyungu, imikorere n'umutekano mu gihe nyacyo.
admin_fraud_console_desc: Suzuma maze uthathe inyathelo ku bikorwa bishidikanywaho.
policy_privacy_intro_p1: Ikaze muri Da-Costa. Twiyemeje kurinda ibanga ryawe mu gihe tuguha umutekano usesuye.
policy_privacy_email_p1: Porogaramu ya Da-Costa itanga uburinzi mu gihe nyacyo kuri BEC.
policy_privacy_email_processing_p1: Porogaramu isesengura ijwi ry'ubutumwa isebenzisa AI.
policy_privacy_email_retention_p1: Tubika gusa igisinyo cy'ijwi mufon yawe.
policy_privacy_email_storage_p1: Ubutumwa bwawe ntibujya kuri sevha zethu.
policy_privacy_email_control_p1: Ushobora gusiba amakuru abitswe igihe cyose.
policy_privacy_rights_p1: Hamwe na GDPR, ufite uburenganzira bwose ku makuru yawe.

firstscreen_description_line2: Ntabwo tubika amakuru yo kwinjira. Narimwe.

auth_error_biometric_not_available: Kwemeza biometrike ntibiboneka kuri iyi gikoresho. Koresha passkey.
premium_lock_desc: Iyi gikoresho kiraboneka gusa ku banywanye ba Premium. Vugurura gahunda yawe kugira ubone uburenganzira.
firstscreen_welcome_desc: Kugenzura passkey byagenze neza. Murakaza neza kuri Da-Costa.
upgrade_billing_2: Kwiyandikisha bisubira bikibwa nta gusabwa keretse bishyizweho cyibuza amasaha 24 mbere y'iherezo ry'igihe.
upgrade_billing_3: Gucunga cyangwa guhagarika igihe icyo aricyo cyose muri Google Play Store. Gukuraho porogaramu ntibihagarika kwiyandikisha kwanyu.

upgrade_footer_2: Gukora AI idafite aho ihuriye: Turasuzuma, ntiturabika.

terms_section1_body: Gukoresheje porogaramu ya Da-Costa, wemera kwuzuzwa n'aya Mategeko y'Serivisi. Niba udabyemera, ntiukoreshe porogaramu.
terms_billing_plans_body: Porogaramu ya Da-Costa itanga kwiyandikisha kwa Premium 'Executive Sentry'. Kwishyura bizakorwa kuri Konti yawe ya Google Play igihe uguze byemejwe.
terms_no_refunds_body: Nka serivisi ya AI idafite aho ihuriye, dutanga agaciro ako kanya igihe ibitangwa. Hakurikijwe amategeko asanzwe ya Google Play, gusubizwa amafaranga ku gice k'igihe cy'ubu biracyaririmbwa. Uburenganzira bwawe buzakomeza kugira ubusobanuro kugeza igihe cyawe cy'ugurishwa kirangiye.
terms_section3_body: Da-Costa itanga ibikoresho byo gusuzuma umutekano wa interineti. Wemera kutakoresha serivisi yacu mu nzira yiyo yose y'uburiganya.
terms_section4_body: Porogaramu ikorera ku mfumo wa freemium. Gukoresha ubuntu gushyigikiwa n'ibirego n'umubare muto w'ibigenzurwa bya buri munsi. Abakoresha bashobora kugura amafaranga y'inyongera cyangwa kwiyandikisha ku gahunda ya premium.
terms_section5_body: Da-Costa ni igikoresho cyo gusuzuma umutekano, si iciganiro cy'umutekano. Ntidushingwa inshingano y'ingaruka zose cyangwa uburyo bwakakaye bwaturutse gukoresha porogaramu.
deletion_request_desc: Ibi bizakura kuri buri gihe konti yawe, amakuru y'ukwiyandikisha, na metadata y'umutekano.
deletion_local_note: Icyitonderwa: Umukono w'Imvugo ya Imeli ugumizwa ku gikoresho cyawe. Kugira ubibeshe, koresha imikorere ya 'Koza Cache' mu mwanya w'igenamiterere rya porogaramu.
deletion_stateless_body: Kuko Da-Costa ikoresha gukora AI idafite aho ihuriye, nta repositori igizwe n'imiyoboro ya mesaje zawe zasuzumwe, URL, cyangwa dosiye zo gusiba. Ibintu byose biracika mu masegonda 30 nyuma yo gukorana.
deletion_initiated_desc: Konti yawe yateganyirijwe gusibwa. Uzasohoka nonaha.
sovereignty_export_toast_desc: Raporo yawe y'ubutegetsi bwa kirurikumwe (GP-2026) yasutswe.
sovereignty_cache_toast_desc: Umukono w'imvugo y'ahantu ugukijwe ku gikoresho cyawe.
